# Spec Template

## 1. Purpose

State the problem this spec solves.

## 2. Scope

In-scope and out-of-scope behaviors.

## 3. Contracts

Define request, response, and error contracts.

## 4. Invariants

Rules that must always hold true.

## 5. Failure Cases

Enumerate expected failure modes and codes.

## 6. Observability

Required events, logs, and metrics.

## 7. Security

Required controls and prohibited behavior.

## 8. Validation

List required unit, integration, contract, and security tests.

## 9. Traceability

Reference capability IDs and traceability matrix rows.
